docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $9,985.40 FILED BY DOROFEY, OLESYA AS TO DEFENDANT PIERCE, CHERYL ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-11-2020 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
ORDER RE: DISMISSAL WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NO APPEEARACNE BY PLAINTIFF. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT CHERYL PIERCE IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF IS NOT PRESENT IN COURT BY 3:40 P.M. DEFENDANT IS INFORMED THAT THE MATTER WILL BE DISMISSED FOR NO APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF AND IS RELEASED FROM COURT. PLAINTIFF APPEARS IN COURT AT 3:45 AFTER DEFENDANT HAS BEEN INFORMED THAT THE CASE IS DISMISSED AND IS NO LONGER PRESENT. JUDGE A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
